capabilities: Change task status with hotkeys or the right-click context menu
Timestamp task creation, completion, and updates
disambiguation: Not a task-list dashboard or query tool; it edits task statuses and text directly in the note being edited.
extras: Full usage documentation is hosted on an external documentation site; the README itself is mostly motivation plus a request for GitHub stars and sponsorships.
motivation: The author created it to make important items (action points, ideas, questions, pros and cons) stand out in cluttered notes, guided by two PTKM Core Principles: task-centered workflow and focus on important matters.
problem: In long notes like meeting summaries, tasks with different statuses are scattered through list items, making them hard to find and update during review.
summary: Task-status plugin that changes and cycles task markers and appends text via hotkeys and the right-click context menu, timestamping each change.
